definition: Task-level funnel. Join keys: task->job on job_name (gives user); task->instance on (job_name, task_name); first instance = earliest start_time, ties by worker_name; instance->machine_spec on machine; instance->sensor and ->machine_metric on worker_name.
label: Failed = 1, Terminated = 0 (trace README: only 'Terminated' tasks are successful). Running and Waiting are unresolved and excluded from S2 on.

stages.stage: S2 resolved: status Failed or Terminated
stages.condition_sql: user IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('Failed','Terminated')
user IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('Failed','Terminated') AND plan_gpu > 0
user IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('Failed','Terminated') AND plan_gpu > 0 AND fi_worker IS NOT NULL

stages.stage: S5 first instance has a machine
stages.condition_sql: user IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('Failed','Terminated') AND plan_gpu > 0 AND fi_machine IS NOT NULL
user IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('Failed','Terminated') AND plan_gpu > 0 AND fi_machine IS NOT NULL AND in_spec

stages.stage: S7 first instance has sensor rows
stages.condition_sql: user IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('Failed','Terminated') AND plan_gpu > 0 AND fi_machine IS NOT NULL AND in_spec AND has_sensor

stages.stage: S8 first instance has machine-metric rows
stages.condition_sql: user IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('Failed','Terminated') AND plan_gpu > 0 AND fi_machine IS NOT NULL AND in_spec AND has_sensor AND has_metric

kanvas_note: KANVAS's own filter is not reproduced here; the comparison is scale only.
